samples.question: A dark reference glyph is shown in the box at the top of the image: two dark filled disks side by side. The relation of a glyph is whether its left disk is larger than its right disk (left-bigger), whether its right disk is larger than its left disk (right-bigger), or whether the two disks are the same size (equal). Below, the image is split into four quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), each containing one dark glyph of two side-by-side disks. Exactly one quadrant's glyph has the SAME left-vs-right size relation as the reference glyph; the other three each have a different relation. Which quadrant contains the glyph whose left-right size relation matches the reference glyph? Answer with the quadrant name.
